name: Nayoro (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Nayoro city emblem in white: two stylised human figures with raised arms.
history: Municipal flag of Nayoro, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 27 March 2006.

features.role: Nayoro city emblem — two stylised human figures with raised arms
